activity.role: Early Geneva Protestant reformer and preacher
activity.notes: First Geneva period 1536–1538, Calvin preached and led early Protestant reforms with Guillaume Farel after 1536 arrival, until expulsion in April 1538. Distinct from his second 1541–1564 Geneva activity; his Strasbourg exile was 1538–1541, not part of either Geneva rail.

sources.citation_text: Calvin served in Geneva from 1536 until expulsion in April 1538, then resided Strasbourg until being recalled to Geneva 1541.
